name: Pink Hill Hotel
lede: A newly built pub and live entertainment venue wanted its outdoor terraces full through the colder months, with nothing taking away from the room. Bromic matched a heater to each ceiling, keeping precise directional heat on the tables and every feature wall in view.
data: Pub and live entertainment venue – outdoor terraces
Eclipse Smart-Heat® Electric · Eclipse Pendant · Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric
Eclipse Dimmer Controller on Eclipse; Tungsten to confirm

hero.caption: Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric on drop poles over the dining terrace.

beats: Pink Hill is a new pub built for live music, with function rooms and outdoor terraces under high ceilings, sections of operable roof and feature walls that give each room its character.

The venue wanted its terraces in use through the colder months without losing the atmosphere. Heaters had to suit ceilings of very different heights, work with only certain parts of the operable roof’s structure and leave every feature wall in view.

After reviewing the site plans, Bromic’s commercial sales team specified a mix: compact Eclipse Pendants under the high fixed ceiling, Eclipse Electric over the dining tables and high-output Tungsten Electric in the larger rooms and under the operable roof.

items.name: Feature-wall lounge
items.text: Higher fixed ceiling. The smaller Eclipse Pendant keeps the view of the feature wall clear.

items.name: Modern dining
items.text: Eclipse Electric gives spot heat and light over each table, on a 24-inch twin pole and a custom pole.

items.name: Industrial-style room
items.text: Tungsten Electric for high output, lowered to a suitable height on a 1200 mm pole.

items.name: Operable roof
items.text: Tungsten Electric mounted on the structural beams and angled toward guests, chosen for Melbourne’s winter.
